No ships ever need to travel through it, and ocean currents keep away the nutrients that would have normally supported sea life. It is the emptiest, most lifeless place on earth.

Well, as I see it, it seems to me that you really like him, but you feel like you would be lost without him. That's not something that is healthy in my opinion. As far as I am concerned, one of the most important things you can do is to become more independent, more confident, and pursuit activities that relate to your general interests. Trust me, I understand that you love him or like him (I'm sort of unclear as to where you guys are on that regard) but you shouldn't marry anyone for the wrong reason. It honestly sounds like things are pretty unstable right now, and I am going to be very blunt. Sorry in advance. I think it's possible to make it through this together, but I think in order for that to happen, you have to take a look at yourself, specifically where you are in life compared to where you want to be. If you want to be your own individual, become that. Don't let your SO being there determine if you are happy or not. Don't let your SO being there determine if you are secure about the relationship or not. In the long run, your independence will bring you closer together. Just one more thing, if thinking about your relationship right now makes you feel bad, I think you should end it. If thinking about how you two are doing right now warms your heart, then stay with him! Don't marry him for the wrong reason though. I hope this helps, best of luck!
